mapper.select: SELECT P.POST_ID, P.WRITER, P.TITLE, P.CONTENT, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.CREATE_AT, DATE_FORMAT(P.CREATE_AT, '%Y.%m.%d %H:%i') AS FORMATTED_CREATE_AT, P.THUMBNAIL_PATH, P.PLACE, P.TRANSPORT_COST, P.FOOD_COST, P.OTHER_COST, -- 명확한 별칭 부여 IU.UPLOAD_ID AS UPLOAD_ID, IU.ORIGIN_NAME AS ORIGIN_NAME, IU.UPLOAD_PATH AS UPLOAD_PATH, IU.IMAGE_ORDER AS IMAGE_ORDER FROM POST P LEFT JOIN POST_UPLOAD PU ON P.POST_ID = PU.POST_ID LEFT JOIN IMAGE_UPLOAD IU ON PU.UPLOAD_ID = IU.UPLOAD_ID WHERE P.POST_ID = #{postId} AND P.IS_BLOCK = FALSE ORDER BY IU.IMAGE_ORDER ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POST ( WRITER, TITLE, CONTENT, VIEW_COUNT, CREATE_AT, IS_BLOCK, THUMBNAIL_PATH, PLACE, TRANSPORT_COST, FOOD_COST, OTHER_COST ) VALUES ( #{writer}, #{title}, #{content}, 0, now(), FALSE, #{thumbnailPath}, #{place}, #{transportCost}, #{foodCost}, #{otherCost} )
mapper.select:
SELECT P.POST_ID, P.WRITER, P.TITLE, P.CONTENT, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.CREATE_AT, P.THUMBNAIL_PATH, -- 🌟 서브쿼리를 날리지 않고 컬럼 값을 다이렉트로 조회하여 부하 제로! DATE_FORMAT(P.CREATE_AT, '%Y.%m.%d %H:%i') AS FORMATTED_CREATE_AT FROM POST P WHERE P.IS_BLOCK = FALSE
AND ( P.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR P.CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY
P.POST_ID ASC
P.POST_ID DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO IMAGE_UPLOAD ( ORIGIN_NAME, STORED_NAME, UPLOAD_PATH, FILE_SIZE, IMAGE_ORDER ) VALUES ( #{originName}, #{storedName}, #{uploadPath}, #{fileSize}, #{imageOrder} )
mapper.select: SELECT IU.UPLOAD_ID, PU.POST_ID, IU.ORIGIN_NAME, IU.STORED_NAME, IU.UPLOAD_PATH, IU.FILE_SIZE, IU.IMAGE_ORDER FROM POST_UPLOAD PU JOIN IMAGE_UPLOAD IU ON IU.UPLOAD_ID = PU.UPLOAD_ID WHERE PU.POST_ID = #{postId} ORDER BY IU.IMAGE_ORDER ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE POST SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, THUMBNAIL_PATH = #{thumbnailPath}, PLACE = #{place}, TRANSPORT_COST = #{transportCost}, FOOD_COST = #{foodCost}, OTHER_COST = #{otherCost}, UPDATE_AT = NOW() WHERE POST_ID = #{postId}
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POST WHERE IS_BLOCK = FALSE
AND ( TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_meta ( original_file_name, stored_file_name, file_path, file_size, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{originalFileName}, #{storedFileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, 'N' )
